parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: <short pause> he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young. <short pause> Isaiah, chapter forty, verse eleven.

Good Shepherd, thank You for gathering me close when I am weak and vulnerable. <short pause> You carry me with tenderness and lead me gently through each day. <short pause> I rest tonight in Your strong and caring arms, trusting Your watchful love over me. <short pause> Amen.
